en: No, it's about something back here,{SAUT}in the movie theater!{PAGE}Remember that door we found that had{SAUT}"Authorized Personnel Only" on it?
Oh, you mean that locked one? What{SAUT}about it?
I suddenly picked up a bizarre, super-{SAUT}strong reading beyond that door.
A reading? You mean an enemy?

No, it's totally new to me―some strange{SAUT}presence, and even Nagi doesn't know{SAUT}what it could be...{PAGE}It's highly unlikely to be Queen and{SAUT}Noir, but I still think we should{SAUT}check it out.
If so, then we'll need to return to the{SAUT}movie theater... It's your call.
Let's head back now.{OPTION}Let's go check it out.
Okay, come back as quick as you can!{SAUT}I'll be waiting!
A mysterious presence, eh? I'm curious{SAUT}as to what it could be...
